MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

5. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

9. Best practice when working on Songs PERFORMING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs PERFORMING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs PERFORMING.
   C. Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs PERFORMING.

10. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Songs PERFORMING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. A — The speed of the music

9. C — Practise Songs PERFORMING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
